# 1. One-time: Fortify the Pillars of Hercules (owns ceuta or tangier, 1360+).
oe_mag_dec_gibraltar_fortress = {
    decision_category = expansion_decisions
    only_once = yes
    only_once_scope = country
    potential = {
        is_rebel_country = no
        current_year >= 1360
        OR = { owns = location:ceuta owns = location:tangier }
        trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_mag_gibraltar_dec_done } NOT = { var:oe_mag_gibraltar_dec_done = 1 } }
    }
    allow = {
        is_subject = no
        gold >= 180
        manpower >= 1.0
    }
    ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
    illustration_tags = { 10 = armed 10 = exterior }
    illustration_scope = { event_illustration_poptype_effect = { foreground = pop_type:soldiers background = pop_type:burghers } }
    option = {
        name = oe_mag_dec_gibraltar_fortress.a
        effect = {
            set_variable = { name = oe_mag_gibraltar_dec_done value = 1 }
            add_gold = -180
            add_manpower = -1.0
            add_navy_tradition = 8
            oe_mag_upgrade_strait_port = yes
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_mag_strait_guard_mod years = 35 mode = replace }
        }
    }
}

# 2. Repeatable (15-year cooldown): Commission the Barbary Taifa of Rais (Muslim holder of algiers / tunis / tripoli, 1492-1660).
oe_mag_dec_barbary_taifa = {
    decision_category = expansion_decisions
    hide_repeatable_tag = yes
    potential = {
        oe_mag_is_muslim_corsair_power = yes
        current_year >= 1492
        current_year <= 1660
        OR = { owns = location:algiers owns = location:tunis owns = location:tripoli }
    }
    allow = {
        gold >= 160
        NOT = { has_variable = oe_mag_taifa_cd }
    }
    ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
    illustration_tags = { 10 = armed 10 = exterior }
    illustration_scope = { event_illustration_poptype_effect = { foreground = pop_type:soldiers background = pop_type:burghers } }
    option = {
        name = oe_mag_dec_barbary_taifa.a
        effect = {
            add_gold = -160
            set_variable = { name = oe_mag_taifa_cd months = 180 }
            add_navy_tradition = 8
            if = {
                limit = { has_global_variable = oe_mag_corsair_heat }
                change_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_corsair_heat add = 1 }
                clamp_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_corsair_heat min = 0 max = 3 }
            }
            else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_corsair_heat value = 1 } }
            oe_mag_upgrade_corsair_haven = yes
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_mag_corsair_commission_mod years = 15 mode = replace }
        }
    }
}

# 3. Repeatable (15-year cooldown): Sponsor Trans-Saharan Gold-Salt Caravan (holds key Sahel or Maghreb terminal, 1350+).
oe_mag_dec_saharan_caravan = {
    decision_category = expansion_decisions
    hide_repeatable_tag = yes
    potential = {
        is_rebel_country = no
        current_year >= 1350
        OR = {
            owns = location:timbuktu
            owns = location:gao
            owns = location:niani
            owns = location:fez
            owns = location:marrakesh
            owns = location:tunis
            oe_mag_has_african_region_presence = yes
        }
    }
    allow = {
        is_subject = no
        gold >= 150
        NOT = { has_variable = oe_mag_caravan_cd }
    }
    ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
    illustration_tags = { 10 = regular 10 = exterior }
    illustration_scope = { event_illustration_poptype_effect = { foreground = pop_type:burghers background = pop_type:peasants } }
    option = {
        name = oe_mag_dec_saharan_caravan.a
        effect = {
            add_gold = -150
            set_variable = { name = oe_mag_caravan_cd months = 180 }
            if = {
                limit = { has_global_variable = oe_mag_gold_surge }
                change_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_gold_surge add = 1 }
                clamp_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_gold_surge min = 1 max = 3 }
            }
            else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_gold_surge value = 1 } }
            if = { limit = { OR = { owns = location:timbuktu owns = location:gao owns = location:niani } } oe_mag_upgrade_wa_caravan_hub = yes }
            else = { oe_mag_upgrade_maghreb_caravan_hub = yes }
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_mag_saharan_caravan_mod years = 15 mode = replace }
        }
    }
}

# 4. One-time: Carthage Naval Patrol (BYZ / ROM controlling tunis + algiers/tripoli or Exarchate Step >= 2).
oe_mag_dec_carthage_patrol = {
    decision_category = expansion_decisions
    only_once = yes
    only_once_scope = country
    potential = {
        oe_mag_is_roman_empire = yes
        oe_mag_roman_controls_tunis = yes
        OR = {
            owns = location:algiers
            owns = location:tripoli
            AND = {
                has_global_variable = oe_mag_exarch_step
                trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_mag_exarch_step } global_var:oe_mag_exarch_step >= 2 }
            }
        }
        trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_mag_patrol_dec_done } NOT = { var:oe_mag_patrol_dec_done = 1 } }
    }
    allow = {
        is_subject = no
        gold >= 240
        manpower >= 2.0
    }
    ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
    illustration_tags = { 10 = armed 10 = exterior }
    illustration_scope = { event_illustration_poptype_effect = { foreground = pop_type:soldiers background = pop_type:burghers } }
    option = {
        name = oe_mag_dec_carthage_patrol.a
        effect = {
            set_variable = { name = oe_mag_patrol_dec_done value = 1 }
            add_gold = -240
            add_manpower = -2.0
            add_navy_tradition = 12
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_corsair_heat value = 0 }
            oe_mag_relieve_ar_strain = { amount = -4 }
            oe_mag_upgrade_imperial_fleet_bases = yes
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_mag_carthage_admiralty_mod years = 40 mode = replace }
        }
    }
}
